senses.gloss: m., pl. כְּרָזֵי name of two species of winged locusts.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 62b:4">Ḥull. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דבי חילפי וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>כְּרָאזֵי</he>) those living in rushes are permitted, <he>דבי כורי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>כרבי</he>, v. <cite ref="K01079"><he>כְּרָבָא</he> II</cite>) those among heaps are forbidden (v. Tosaf. a. l.).
